Name: Magic Tarots (Json Assets)
Author: notomention
Description:
1. install smapi
2. install Content patcher/ json assets / mail framework
3. Extract the .rar file via winrar or 7zip
4. Paste in /Mod folder
5. Finish! 
-Be sure to update my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8646]Magic Tree Roots[/url] mod if you already had it so this wont cause conflict :D



-The card are tie to The Wizard friendship , be friend with him to get them card.
 What will be your fate today
Quest spoiler
﻿[spoiler] Quest line with the wizard
 * At 1 heart he will give you 22 of the "magic tarot card" item..better just toss them into the shipping bin  :^)
 * After that there is 25% change for him to give you the item recipe if you want to make more*
 * At 3 hearts he would give you 1 magic tarot sapling + a fortune telling via the mail (10% chance to happen each day, tell me if the change was too small or too big.)
 * at 6 heart and after shipped a lot of the magic tarot card he will give you all of 22 sapling kind at one so be sure to have space in your bag  :) [/spoiler]
